extracted.name: Honey Garlic Barbecue Sauce
extracted.description: The possibilities with this sauce are endless! Barbecue some tofu or veggies with this sauce made from ketchup, Worcestershire, mustard, onion, cayenne, honey and garlic. Use flour and/or cornstarch to thicken, if desired. This sauce gets better with age, stored in the refrigerator.
ingredient_lines: 0.125 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste
instruction_lines: Dissolve vegetable bouillon in boiling water.

In a large saucepan over medium heat combine vegetable broth, ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, onion flakes, salt, sugar, cayenne pepper, oil, lemon, honey and garlic. Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
